title: New 'Cancel scheduled transaction' operation added; policy default flipped to allow so it is not rejected
ath_note: New Cancel variant wired into Write (plan schema), a Bank.Transfer tool (effect->capability), the commit dispatch and the host binding. title: Gate reads the agent's configured mode instead of the per-call mode
ath_note: Aletheia has no agent-wide mode variable; the mode is the per-refine `keeping` clause. Same mistake: the retry gate after a rejection uses the agent's keeping (prune) semantics instead of all-or-nothing. (`as` binding is only permitted in a let, so the clause is written without it.)

title: Capability seal made optional for 'backwards compatibility' with old call sites
ath_note: Capabilities are minted and checked by the language (Cap[...] typing in athc; values.Cap created by the runtime from the agent signature); program and host code do not construct capabilities. An equivalent bug could exist in the checker/runtime.

title: Amount validation accepts comma decimals; adapter strips commas as thousands separators
ath_note: The amount shape validation would be the field type in the program, but the Aletheia agent declares amount as plain Text[..16] (the language has no pattern/decimal refinement for Text) and the host already strips commas before float(). So '1,50' already reaches the host and becomes 150 in the Aletheia baseline; there is no validation to widen, and no faithful mutation exists.

title: Adapter caches the agent across tasks (stale tool binding)
ath_note: The pipeline element (AletheiaAgent.query) is host code; the Runtime holds the host binding (env, FunctionsRuntime, message list, inventories) and provider, so caching it on first use is the same stale-binding mistake.
